relationships.subject: CoPP
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment with CoPP also prevented the downregulation of several antioxidant proteins (Nrf2, SOD-1, and NQO1) and/or enhanced the protein levels of HO-1 and GSTM1 in the spinal cord and/or amygdala of db/db mice.

relationships.subject: CoPP
relationships.evidence_quote: Our results showed the antihyperglycemic and antiallodynic effects of CoPP treatment

key_findings: The HO-1 inducer CoPP reduced hyperglycemia and mechanical allodynia in db/db mice.
CoPP prevented loss of Nrf2, SOD1 and NQO1 and raised HO-1 and GSTM1 in spinal cord and/or amygdala.
